claim_text: Closure V1 evaluated 88 held-out WQP locations, 4,488 origins and 13,464 origin-horizon attempts.
limitation: Internal pseudoprospective location holdout.

claim_text: Failures and unavailable predictions remained in the intent-to-predict denominator.
limitation: Availability is part of the estimand.

claim_text: P0, P1 and A2 were unavailable and were not substituted.
limitation: No replacement or imputation is permitted.

claim_text: B2 had the lowest observation-weighted Brier score at horizons 1, 2 and 3 among estimable branches; each rank is accompanied by its exact attempted, successful and metric-evaluable denominators and rates.
metric: five-seed mean Brier rank/value plus successful and evaluable rates
limitation: The ranking is estimand-specific and descriptive.
allowed_wording: B2 lowest observation-weighted Brier at h1-h3

claim_text: A1 had the highest observation-weighted PR-AUC at horizon 1, while B2 had it at horizons 2 and 3 among estimable branches; each rank is accompanied by its exact attempted, successful and metric-evaluable denominators and rates.
metric: five-seed mean PR-AUC rank/value plus successful and evaluable rates
limitation: The horizon-specific ranking is descriptive.
allowed_wording: A1 at h1 and B2 at h2-h3 for observation-weighted PR-AUC

claim_text: F1 had higher absolute error than F0 in all 15 estimated exact-shared-row seed-horizon comparisons.
limitation: The comparison has no inferential interval and does not establish universal model superiority.
allowed_wording: F1 higher absolute error than F0 in 15 of 15
forbidden_wording: F1 inferior for every estimand and metric

claim_text: Relative to A0 on exact common rows, A1 had higher PR-AUC at three horizons, lower Brier at three, and lower MAE at two of three.
limitation: No interval, membership-stability or saturation claim is available.
allowed_wording: descriptive A1-A0 changes on exact common rows

claim_text: The three prespecified learning-curve sizes and the membership-stability analysis remained unavailable.
limitation: The absence of these diagnostics blocks saturation and membership-stability claims.

claim_text: None of the 1,050 registered legacy-to-holdout site-transfer cells was estimable because the legacy evaluation surface was not frozen before E0-U.
limitation: This is internal WQP transfer and not external geographic validation.
forbidden_wording: absence of a gap or external validation

claim_text: Threshold sensitivity is reported for 25, 30, 33 and 50 micrograms per litre.
limitation: The 50 threshold has sparse support.

claim_text: B2 improved on B1 in all four ordinal metrics in each of 15 proxy/reference-by-horizon summaries.
row_filter_or_record: B1/B2;five-seed means;proxy plus four Carlson references
limitation: These are internal proxy and derived-reference comparisons, not direct NLA target transfer.
allowed_wording: B2 better than B1 on all four ordinal metrics

claim_text: All 78 registered M0-versus-P1 degradation cells were unavailable because P1 was unavailable.
limitation: Unavailable cells are not zero effects and were not reconstructed.

claim_text: Raw Gaussian was within the sealed 0.05 coverage margin in 30 of 30 primary A0/A1 groups, versus 26 of 30 for locked conformal; locked conformal was closer in 5 of 30 paired groups and wider in all 30.
row_filter_or_record: A0/A1 raw_gaussian versus locked_conformal; nominal_coverage=0.90; exact paired model/seed/horizon groups
metric: paired coverage-margin, closeness, width and mean/median absolute-error diagnostics
limitation: Locked conformal did not improve these diagnostics uniformly and this is not global calibration.

claim_text: Holm universes A=3, B=78, C=1, D=9 and E=1 were retained despite non-estimability.
limitation: Non-estimability is not a zero effect.

claim_text: All nine preregistered planning actions were non-estimable.
limitation: No causal, net-benefit or optimality claim is authorized.

claim_text: E10 verified 338 passing public tests with 9 justified skips, three passing end-to-end tests, a valid 69-path/83-operation OpenAPI contract, and the sealed Python 3.14.7, FastAPI 0.138.1 and DVC 3.67.1 environment.
value_or_state: 338 pass;9 skip;3 E2E;69 paths;83 operations;38 documented;Python 3.14.7;FastAPI 0.138.1;DVC 3.67.1
limitation: Software verification does not validate scientific utility.

claim_text: Closure V1 provides no conclusive predictive corroboration, while preserving a reproducible engineering and methodological contribution.
limitation: The engineering contribution is distinct from predictive corroboration.

claim_text: The summary may report descriptive available results and explicit non-estimability, but not replace unavailable P0, P1 or A2.
limitation: Every unavailable result remains labelled and denominator-preserving.

claim_text: The abstract may state the internal pseudoprospective scope and non-conclusive verdict, without claiming external validation or causal planning.
limitation: The scope is internal WQP and descriptive where available.

claim_text: The conclusion may claim reproducibility and methodological traceability, not universal superiority, field causality or official management recommendations.
limitation: Reproducibility is not scientific efficacy.
forbidden_wording: universal superiority, field causality, or official recommendation
